rest_facing: Both GLBs face +Z at rest (glTF forward). Rusana's root/origin stays at her feet; all strike motion is in-place (the knee step-in/step-out happens inside the pose, root does not move).

placement.note: Same placement for both strikes (no repositioning between kick and knee). Put the guy DISTANCE m in front of Rusana along her facing, turned 180 deg. Both roots on the floor, no lateral offset.
placement.distance_is: object root to object root (what the engine sets)
placement.general: guy.position = rus.position + forward(rus.rotation.y) * 0.667; guy.rotation.y = rus.rotation.y + Math.PI
placement.guy_stance: feet 0.58 m apart, groin (crotch seam) at 0.794 m, butt plane 0.095 m behind his pelvis

guy_sync: Before a strike the guy plays 'idle' (kick) or 'clinched' (knee, started together with rus_knee at t=0). At contact_time: hit-stop 0.06 s, then 'flinch' (kick) / 'flinch_knee' (knee) from t=0 with fade <=0.05 s. Their last frame == double_over f0, so chain double_over (optionally insert 'stun' loop first to extend the frozen beat).

kick_up.starts_from: fight stance at the placement distance (no step-in; no rus_approach clip needed)
kick_up.retract: f9 -> f13 back down the same arc (0.133 s), foot on floor f17, stance f22

keys.f3 (0.10 s): support heel lifting (+2.8 cm), lean-back starts
keys.f5 (0.167 s): chamber: knee 0.56 m, thigh 43 deg below horizontal, shin vertical, heel +4.8 cm, lean back ~10 deg
keys.f6-f7: knee rises, shin swings forward-up from below

kick_up.contact_point_m: instep at groin center, 0.762 m high = 3.2 cm below his crotch seam; toe/shoe stays 10 cm in front of his butt plane

guy_sequence.note: after 0.06 s hit-stop: pelvis snaps back 7 cm, knees cave, hands to groin (clip 0.067-0.20 s), then frozen beat / mouth open (0.20-0.40 s)
loop to lengthen the frozen beat
gradual fold + 0.30 m stagger back (see double_over_root_motion)

knee.starts_from: fight stance at the same placement distance; she steps in (f0-f6, in-pose) to 0.33-0.34 m pelvis-to-pelvis, grabs behind his neck (pulls him down ~2.2 cm), knees, releases f16-f20, steps back to stance by f30
knee.drive: 0.10 s upward drive after contact (f12->f15), knee drops f16-f19
knee.contact_point_m: right kneecap into groin from below; knee joint 0.72 m at contact, 0.765 m at peak (kneecap top ~0.80 m); his crotch rises to ~0.82 as he goes up on his toes

guy_sequence.note: start together with rus_knee (t=0); neck pulled down, ends exactly at contact
after hit-stop: hips back, rises onto toes 3.5 cm, hands go out then to groin, knees cave late (after her knee drops), frozen beat to 0.40 s
Rusana is stepping back at the same time (rus_knee f23-f30)

walk.note: Scale mixer timeScale = moveSpeed / 0.78 for other speeds.

clinched: once, NEW: pulled down by the neck before the knee
flinch_knee: once, NEW: knee reaction, rises onto toes
double_over: once, holds last pose; includes 0.30 m stagger back

morph_targets.note: Expression weights are keyed inside every clip (weights channel on the *_body node), so AnimationMixer drives faces automatically.

loading: Meshopt-compressed + WebP textures: GLTFLoader needs loader.setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder) (three/examples/jsm/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js).
outfit_masking: Body mesh carries a custom vertex attribute _ZONE (three.js: geometry.attributes._zone, RGBA zone codes; NOT used as vertex color) (see out/*_masks.json) for hiding skin under clothes if outfits are swapped.
playback: Clips marked 'once' must use action.setLoop(THREE.LoopOnce) + clampWhenFinished=true. Loop clips: rus_idle, rus_walk, idle, stun, floor, hurt. Each clip's glTF extras carry {loop, fps, frames, duration}.

hit_stop.note: Engine-side: at contact_time freeze BOTH mixers (timeScale 0) for 0.06 s, then resume. Clip timings below are clip time; with hit-stop, real time after contact = clip time + 0.06 s. flinch/flinch_knee also hold f0->f1 (1 frame) to match Rusana's contact hold.

double_over_root_motion.note: double_over contains 0.30 m of backward travel (two steps) in the skeleton. When it finishes, move the guy object 0.30 m back along HIS facing (away from Rusana: guy.position += forward(guy.rotation.y) * -0.30) and then play knees/hurt/getup/floor/tap, which are authored in place from that spot.
